title: Backlit person (silhouette)
purpose: Geometry identical to s01 so the only variable is light.

prediction.rationale: The deliverable is the delta against s01 flown the same day (mean confidence, tracked fraction, heading error), not a pass/fail. MATTE 2026-09-14: no numeric claims before; the static delta against s01 is now measured. Matte whole-scene preview (backlit): 0.381 / 0.717 / 0.984 at 3.0 / 2.0 / 1.0 m versus s01 (default light, same geometry) 0.980 / 1.000 / 0.996. Single-subject float/clean 0.653/0.480/0.260 at 2.0/3.0/3.5 m, chip/clean 0.684/0.394/0.228, himax at 3.0 m 0.361 float / 0.318 chip; silhouette contrast about -75 to -100 DN. At the declared 3.0 m the backlit person is below BOTH bars on every probe. Bar: these notes were written against --vis-enter 0.70 on the 20%-reflective floor; 0.75 ships since 2026-09-13. [probe key: float/clean = champion float net via build_scene.py --preview preprocessing; chip = firmware preprocess + model_id_dory.onnx; himax = himax_typical camera, mean of 2 draws; single-subject probe = this cutout alone, static, straight ahead, camera on the eye line; full tables in docs/eval_results/2026-09-14-scene-notes]
